title: Echopoint deploy gate failed 7 times: the CLI Action downloaded its binary anonymously during a GitHub anonymous-traffic incident
service: echopoint-cli GitHub Action, infra Deploy Router
summary: From 05:16Z on 2026-11-09, GitHub answered **504** to anonymous requests for release assets while authenticated requests still got 200 (GitHub incident *Increased timeouts due to surge in anonymous users*). The echopoint deploy of #794 (Deploy Router run 42566238183) failed all 7 attempts in 45 minutes: the flow gate could not download the echopoint CLI and the frontend jobs could not download the apispec wasm, so no flow ran. Prod was not held: the next deploy (#795, which contains #794) hit a gap in the 504s and promoted to prod at 05:58Z. The echopoint CLI composite Action, which customers also pin as `@v1`, downloaded its own binary with an anonymous `curl` and no retry. echopoint-cli#98 now sends the workflow token, retries, and falls back to an anonymous request; it shipped as v3.14.2 and moved `v1` at 06:29Z.

impact.text: CI and deploy pipeline only. The echopoint deploy of #794 failed 7 times and paged the deploy-failure alert 7 times; the same commit reached prod 43 minutes later through the next deploy. Every caller of `nanostack-dev/echopoint-cli@v1` (the post-deploy gates, and any customer workflow) was exposed to the same failure for the length of the GitHub incident; customer runs are not measurable from here.

numbers.label: failed attempts of one deploy run
flows run by the failed gate

trigger: GitHub throttled anonymous traffic: anonymous `GET github.com/…/releases/download/…` answered 504 in about 70 ms; the same request with a token answered 200.
detection: The gate failed at once (`curl: (22) … 504`) and `alert-deploy-failure` fired on every attempt. The error the gate printed, *No flow results: the suite failed before running a flow*, did not say that a third-party download failed, so the run was rerun six times. The routine found the cause at 06:15Z by reading the job logs and githubstatus.
resolution: Mitigated when the #795 deploy (05:54Z) downloaded the CLI in a gap of the 504s and promoted c6989ae8 (with #794) to prod at 05:58Z. Fixed by echopoint-cli#98 (authenticated download, retries, anonymous fallback), released as v3.14.2 with `v1` moved at 06:29Z. The frontend `postinstall` download gets the same treatment in a separate fix (A2).

whys.problem: The echopoint deploy of #794 failed its post-deploy gate 7 times in 45 minutes without running a flow

because.text: The gate could not install the echopoint CLI: the release download answered 504
because.evidence: Job 128993798293 (and every later attempt): `curl: (22) The requested URL returned error: 504` at *Download echopoint CLI*

because.text: GitHub answered 504 to anonymous release requests; requests with a token got 200
because.evidence: githubstatus incident *Increased timeouts due to surge in anonymous users* (05:59Z); local probe 06:15Z: anonymous 504 in 0.07 s, `Authorization: Bearer` 200 in 0.4 s on the same URL

because.text: The CLI Action downloaded its binary with a plain anonymous curl, no token and no retry
because.evidence: `echopoint-cli/action.yml` before #98: `curl -fsSL -o … "$url"`; a TODO marked the step as v1 hardening debt

because.text: Our CI tools fetch their own binaries from github.com anonymously at run time, so GitHub's anonymous tier is a hard dependency of every gate
The frontend typecheck and build jobs failed too: pnpm postinstall could not fetch the apispec wasm
fetch-apispec-wasm.mjs uses an anonymous fetch with no retry, and the install step has no token in its env
Build steps download release assets anonymously, with no token passed by the reusable workflows
The same run was rerun six times over 42 minutes, each a deterministic failure that paged the alert again
The gate error said only *No flow results: the suite failed before running a flow*, not that a third-party download got 504
The gate reports a setup failure (tool download) like a flow failure, so nothing tells a responder that a rerun cannot help
The download flaw sat in a public action since v1 and shipped untested again in the fix
because.evidence: `Action Sandbox Integration` was `skipped` on #98 and on main (no sandbox secrets, `ECHOPOINT_SANDBOX_ENABLED` unset)

because.text: The only test of the action needs a live sandbox org's secrets, never set; the download steps have no test that runs without an API
because.evidence: `.github/workflows/action-sandbox.yml`: gated on `vars.ECHOPOINT_SANDBOX_ENABLED`, skips when `ECHOPOINT_SANDBOX_*` secrets are absent

because.text: action.yml has no CI that runs it without a live org, so action changes reach `v1` unexercised

contributing: GitHub's 504s were intermittent, so runs that hit a gap passed and hid the pattern.
A GitHub incident with the same shape (timeouts for unauthenticated users) happened the day before, 10:36-12:32Z, without hitting a gate.

well: The gate failed closed: no deploy promoted without flows running.
Job logs named the exact URL and status, so the cause was clear once read.
wrong: Six reruns of a deterministic failure, each paging the alert.
A known v1 TODO in a public action's download step was never closed.
lucky: The #793 and #795 deploys hit gaps in the 504s and promoted prod, so nothing was held. With continuous 504s every deploy of both products would have stopped at dev.
No customer report: any customer pinning `@v1` would have seen the same failure during the incident.
#98 had no CI that runs the action; a local simulation under macOS bash 3.2 was the only test before `v1` moved.

actions.what: CLI Action downloads with the workflow token (`github-token` input), retries, anonymous fallback; release v3.14.2, move v1
fetch-apispec-wasm sends GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_TOKEN when set and retries 5xx; infra frontend install steps pass GITHUB_TOKEN
Gate names a failed setup step and its HTTP status (e.g. `SETUP-FAILED download-cli 504: rerun after githubstatus is green`) instead of the generic no-results error
Add a hermetic action job (resolve + download + `echopoint --help` on linux/macos/windows) that runs on every action.yml PR; enable the live sandbox when secrets exist
Workspace AGENTS.md: CI downloads from github.com send the workflow token and retry

messaging.internal: Echopoint deploy of #794 failed 7 times 05:15-06:00Z: GitHub 504'd anonymous release downloads (CLI Action, frontend wasm). Prod not held (#795 promoted at 05:58Z). Fixed in echopoint-cli#98 (v3.14.2, v1 moved); frontend fix in progress.
messaging.external: None sent. If a customer reports `curl: (22) … 504` from the Echopoint GitHub Action on 2026-11-09: GitHub throttled anonymous downloads; `@v1` now downloads with the workflow token.
